Hartel, the reserve rider, takes the lead in Heat 20, putting Germany in a strong position.
The commentators highlight the high stakes of the final race, with a 3-all result securing Germany's qualification for the World Final.
Germany achieves the 3-all result, securing their place in the World Final.
